background_story: Snookums was a gentle cat with a coat as soft as the petals of an azalea flower. She lived in a cozy little house with her owner, an elderly botanist who adored her. The botanist's garden was famous for its vibrant azalea bushes, which bloomed every spring in a riot of color. Snookums loved to spend her days lounging among the flowers, chasing the occasional butterfly, and purring contentedly as the warm sun shone down on her. As the azaleas bloomed, Snookums would weave in and out of the bushes, her tail twitching with excitement. She was especially fond of the delicate pink azaleas, which matched the color of her nose. The botanist would often joke that Snookums was the true queen of the azalea garden, and that the flowers bloomed just for her.

context_rules.text: If Snookums either drinks milk or has a full stomach, then she is happy.
If Snookums has whiskers, then she enjoys gardens and is curious.
For any cat, if it has a full stomach and feels relaxed, then it will take a nap.
All cats that chase butterflies are playful.
If Snookums has a soft coat, then she loves flowers and enjoys gardens.
If Snookums either curls up tightly or purrs contentedly (but not both), then she feels relaxed.
Every cat that enjoys sunlight either plays outdoors or chases butterflies (or both).
If a cat purrs contentedly and plays outdoors, then it brings joy.
If Snookums lives with a botanist, then she loves flowers and brings joy.
